items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: and then there's me and then my brother Rudolph. He was the youngest.

ctx.x: I forgot to ask you, did you have an brothers or sisters.

Yeah, I had two sisters and a brother. I had another brother but he died. I think that's -- my sister's name was -- one was Edna, she was the oldest. Viola was the next and then my brother he came next and he's the one that died and then there's me and then my brother Rudolph. He was the youngest.
You had two brothers, then. And two sisters.
